points.sentence: Blotato has no direct integration with Dropbox, Google Drive, or other cloud storage.

points.point: Will a share link work as the media URL
points.sentence: Get a public direct file URL for the image or video (a link to the file itself, not a shared preview page).

verdict.reason: The entry says iCloud-style cloud storage has no integration and that media needs a public direct file URL rather than a shared preview page, which answers whether a share link will work.
